---
description: Generated by go42x from .go42x/go42x.yaml; import this MCP configuration into agentic workflows.
mcp-servers:
  context7:
    type: http
    url: https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.CONTEXT7_API_KEY }}
    allowed:
      - '*'
  github:
    type: http
    url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer ${{ github.token }}
      X-MCP-Toolsets: all
    allowed:
      - '*'
  go42x:
    container: ghcr.io/go42-dev/go42x
    version: ${{ env.GO42X_MCP_IMAGE_VERSION }}
    entrypoint: go42x
    entrypointArgs:
      - mcp
    mounts:
      - ${{ github.workspace }}:${{ github.workspace }}:rw
    type: stdio
    args:
      - --workdir
      - ${{ github.workspace }}
    allowed:
      - '*'
  gopls:
    container: ghcr.io/go42-dev/go42x
    version: ${{ env.GO42X_MCP_IMAGE_VERSION }}
    entrypoint: gopls
    entrypointArgs:
      - mcp
    mounts:
      - ${{ github.workspace }}:${{ github.workspace }}:rw
    type: stdio
    args:
      - --workdir
      - ${{ github.workspace }}
    allowed:
      - '*'
  mise:
    container: ghcr.io/go42-dev/go42x
    version: ${{ env.GO42X_MCP_IMAGE_VERSION }}
    entrypoint: mise
    entrypointArgs:
      - mcp
    mounts:
      - ${{ github.workspace }}:${{ github.workspace }}:rw
    type: stdio
    args:
      - --workdir
      - ${{ github.workspace }}
    env:
      MISE_DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME: etc/mise.toml
      MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}/etc/mise.toml
    allowed:
      - '*'
---
